An AI technology company. One centralized, AI-optimized infrastructure that puts the tools, data, and reach media entrepreneurs could never build alone directly into their hands.
Three products run the loop.
One to generate language from live data, one to create video at machine volume, and one to monetize and personalize every impression. Every partner gets the full stack on day one.
An industry leader in automated, data-driven natural language generation. Infosentience turns live structured data into accurate, on-brand stories. AI content at scale, running in production today.

Our proprietary video production engine that transforms and distributes video content and accompanying articles. Long-form video and audio come in; publish-ready cut-downs, captions, and posts go out, then straight to every channel an audience already lives on.
The engine behind Paradium.AI's monetization and personalization. Encore reads first-party signals and matches the right content, offer, and format to every person, so the same audience earns more.
Not employment. Not a utility. Co-ownership.
Creators keep their name, their beat, and their equity. The platform hands them the tools, data, and reach on day one, and takes the operating weight off.
Mike Bloom Survivor & competition reality
Sharon Tharp Food, home & everyday living
Dan Kline Retail, restaurants & consumer markets

Our people are the core of our technology.

While we supercharge with AI, our people remain at the absolute core of the business. This technology is designed to elevate our teams, not replace them. Bleeding-edge tools in the hands of the operators who know what to do with them.

pages.raw_title: Cutter Studios™ — drop a video in, get a week of content out
pages.raw_meta: Cutter Studios turns one long-form video into cut-downs, captions, posts and a companion article, then ships them to every channel.
raw_blocks: Turn long-form into a content engine.
It finds the moments, cuts them to every ratio, burns the captions and writes the article.
Whatever you already press record on.
If it's long, it's fuel. Cutter reads it once and keeps producing from it.
Every guest becomes a week of verticals and a companion article.
Audio-first shows get watchable, captioned cuts and audiograms.
Product moments pulled, reframed and posted while they're hot.
The clip and the article land together, same hour.
Streams and panels cut down before the room clears out.
Moments scored and out to the feeds before the takes cool.
An hour of slides becomes a month of shareable proof points.
Everything you've already published, run overnight, live again.
Cut by Cutter. Posted in minutes.
